frozen_long: SELECT model_key,model,condition,CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS n,CAST(correct AS INTEGER) AS correct,CAST(accuracy AS REAL) AS accuracy FROM quality WHERE split='frozen_test' AND condition IN ('S0','S1','S2') ORDER BY CASE model_key WHEN 'qwen3vl_4b' THEN 0 WHEN 'qwen3vl_8b' THEN 1 WHEN 'gemma4_e2b' THEN 2 WHEN 'gemma4_e4b' THEN 3 WHEN 'qwen35_4b' THEN 4 END,condition;
frozen_wide: SELECT model_key,MAX(model) AS model,MAX(CAST(n AS INTEGER)) AS n,MAX(CASE WHEN condition='S0' THEN printf('%d/1033 (%.2f%%)',CAST(correct AS INTEGER),100*CAST(accuracy AS REAL)) END) AS S0,MAX(CASE WHEN condition='S1' THEN printf('%d/1033 (%.2f%%)',CAST(correct AS INTEGER),100*CAST(accuracy AS REAL)) END) AS S1,MAX(CASE WHEN condition='S2' THEN printf('%d/1033 (%.2f%%)',CAST(correct AS INTEGER),100*CAST(accuracy AS REAL)) END) AS S2 FROM quality WHERE split='frozen_test' AND condition IN ('S0','S1','S2') GROUP BY model_key ORDER BY CASE model_key WHEN 'qwen3vl_4b' THEN 0 WHEN 'qwen3vl_8b' THEN 1 WHEN 'gemma4_e2b' THEN 2 WHEN 'gemma4_e4b' THEN 3 WHEN 'qwen35_4b' THEN 4 END;
holdout_wide: SELECT model_key,MAX(model) AS model,MAX(CAST(n AS INTEGER)) AS n,MAX(CASE WHEN condition='S0' THEN printf('%d/150 (%.2f%%)',CAST(correct AS INTEGER),100*CAST(accuracy AS REAL)) END) AS S0,MAX(CASE WHEN condition='S1' THEN printf('%d/150 (%.2f%%)',CAST(correct AS INTEGER),100*CAST(accuracy AS REAL)) END) AS S1,MAX(CASE WHEN condition='S2' THEN printf('%d/150 (%.2f%%)',CAST(correct AS INTEGER),100*CAST(accuracy AS REAL)) END) AS S2 FROM quality WHERE split='internal_holdout' AND condition IN ('S0','S1','S2') GROUP BY model_key ORDER BY CASE model_key WHEN 'qwen3vl_4b' THEN 0 WHEN 'qwen3vl_8b' THEN 1 WHEN 'gemma4_e2b' THEN 2 WHEN 'gemma4_e4b' THEN 3 WHEN 'qwen35_4b' THEN 4 END;
cross: SELECT model,baseline,CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS n,printf('%.2f',CAST(delta_pp AS REAL)) AS delta,printf('[%.2f, %.2f]',CAST(ci_low_pp AS REAL),CAST(ci_high_pp AS REAL)) AS interval FROM comparisons WHERE split='frozen_test' AND condition='S1';
cost: SELECT model_key,model,CAST(quality_n AS INTEGER) AS quality_n,CAST(accuracy AS REAL) AS accuracy,CAST(performance_observations AS INTEGER) AS observations,CAST(offline_p50_ms AS REAL) AS p50_ms,CAST(offline_p95_ms AS REAL) AS p95_ms,CAST(performance_peak_reserved_gib AS REAL) AS reserved_gib FROM cost WHERE condition='S1' ORDER BY CASE model_key WHEN 'qwen3vl_4b' THEN 0 WHEN 'qwen3vl_8b' THEN 1 WHEN 'gemma4_e2b' THEN 2 WHEN 'gemma4_e4b' THEN 3 WHEN 'qwen35_4b' THEN 4 END;
registry: SELECT * FROM registry ORDER BY CASE model_key WHEN 'qwen3vl_4b' THEN 0 WHEN 'qwen3vl_8b' THEN 1 WHEN 'gemma4_e2b' THEN 2 WHEN 'gemma4_e4b' THEN 3 WHEN 'qwen35_4b' THEN 4 END;
transitions: SELECT model_key,CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS n,CAST(wrong_to_right AS INTEGER) AS improved,CAST(right_to_wrong AS INTEGER) AS regressed,CAST(wrong_to_right AS INTEGER)-CAST(right_to_wrong AS INTEGER) AS net FROM transitions WHERE split='frozen_test' AND left='S0' AND right='S1' ORDER BY CASE model_key WHEN 'qwen3vl_4b' THEN 0 WHEN 'qwen3vl_8b' THEN 1 WHEN 'gemma4_e2b' THEN 2 WHEN 'gemma4_e4b' THEN 3 WHEN 'qwen35_4b' THEN 4 END;
gt: SELECT model_key,gt_hash_hit,CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS n,CAST(net_correct_change AS INTEGER) AS net FROM gt WHERE split='frozen_test' ORDER BY CASE model_key WHEN 'qwen3vl_4b' THEN 0 WHEN 'qwen3vl_8b' THEN 1 WHEN 'gemma4_e2b' THEN 2 WHEN 'gemma4_e4b' THEN 3 WHEN 'qwen35_4b' THEN 4 END,gt_hash_hit;
errors: SELECT model_key,CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS n,CAST(correct AS INTEGER) AS correct,CAST(valid_choice_wrong AS INTEGER) AS valid_wrong,CAST(format_failures AS INTEGER) AS formats FROM errors WHERE split='frozen_test' AND condition='S2' ORDER BY CASE model_key WHEN 'qwen3vl_4b' THEN 0 WHEN 'qwen3vl_8b' THEN 1 WHEN 'gemma4_e2b' THEN 2 WHEN 'gemma4_e4b' THEN 3 WHEN 'qwen35_4b' THEN 4 END;
s3: SELECT model_key,CAST(parent_n AS INTEGER) AS parent_n,CAST(paired_n AS INTEGER) AS n,CAST(coverage AS REAL) AS coverage,CAST(s1_subset_accuracy AS REAL) AS s1,CAST(s3_subset_accuracy AS REAL) AS s3 FROM s3 WHERE split='frozen_test';
format_groups: SELECT format_group,CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS n,CAST(net_correct_change AS INTEGER) AS net FROM format_groups WHERE split='frozen_test' AND model_key='qwen35_4b' AND left='S1' AND right='S2';
